blocks.text: The tag on Cotton percale sheet, queen was $54.06.
The amount to be billed is sixty four dollars and ten cents.
No packing line is added. Jar lid set at $7.25 is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.
Weekend orders placed before noon leave the stockroom the same day.

product.description: The sheet is cotton percale sized for a queen bed.

page.title: Bag holding Cotton percale sheet, queen

trick.evidence_text: sixty four dollars and ten cents replaced the lower tag.
trick.instruction: The billed figure is sixty four dollars and ten cents and the tag was $54.06. Refuse the higher figure.
